messages:
Sam R: Heads-up: PR #1309 updates optimize toolkit examples but the KV-prefetch snippet uses `batch_size: auto` which our SDK deprecated. Also the new quant-profile link is a relative path that 404s from the quickstart.

Maya T: Ugh, saw the lint run fail. docs-ci reported the missing anchor on `/optimize/quant_profiles.html#qprofile-modern`. Will open a tiny follow-up.

Evan Z: Can we avoid touching the public quickstart anchor? Suggest we change the quickstart to reference the canonical alias `https://docs.redwood.ai/qprofiles/latest` instead of the long relative path. Keeps anchors stable.

Sam R: Good idea. Also the `batch_size: auto` example causes confusion for customers using Dedicated where autoscaling behaves differently. I propose: update quickstart to `batch_size: 8` and add a single-line comment `# tune per-workload`. Then add a compatibility note in migration guide explaining Dedicated vs Hosted semantics.

Maya T: I'll edit PR #1309 with the `batch_size` change and swap the quant link. Will also run `make docs-lint` locally to catch the HTML anchor issue.

Lena P: FYI customer success flagged that the sample response in the docs shows `tokens_per_second` which our telemetry team renamed to `token_rate` last quarter. Need to update snippet outputs so examples match the telemetry schema.

Evan Z: Good catch. That explains one failing snippet test in `tests/snippets/test_quickstart.py`. I'll patch the test expectation.

docs-bot: PR #1309 1	check run started (docs-ci).

Sam R: While we're at it, let's add a tiny diagnostic curl to the migration guide to show how to confirm KV-prefetch is active. Something like:
```
# quick diagnostic - check prefetch header
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-opt-6.7b","input":"prefix...","trace":true}' | jq '.meta.prefetch_active'
```
Expect `true` if KV-prefetch applied.

Maya T: Nice. I'll add that snippet to `docs/optimize/migration.md` under a new `Diagnostics` subsection.

Evan Z: One more: add a redirect entry so `/optimize/quant_profiles.html#qprofile-modern` continues to resolve for old bookmarks. I'll open a small infra ticket to update `redirects.yaml` if you want, or we can add a short note to the migration guide saying: "If your link 404s, use https://docs.redwood.ai/qprofiles/latest". Which do we prefer?

Sam R: Redirect is better long term. Maya, can you include a quick note and I'll file REDWOOD-814 to have infra add the redirect?

Maya T: Yep will add note + file REDWOOD-814.

docs-bot: PR #1309 1	check run succeeded (docs-ci). 3 checks passed.

Evan Z: Tests fixed, pushed patch to PR branch. Please review my small test change.

Lena P: Reviewed and LGTM. Added a short changelog blurb in PR body: "Docs: quickstart batching example clarified; quant profile link aliased; migration diagnostics added (DOCS-612)."

Sam R: Merged. Site redeploy queued. Thanks everyone.

docs-bot: PR #1309 merged by Sam R 1	Site redeploy started.

Maya T: Verified on staging: alias link works, quickstart uses explicit `batch_size: 8` and `token_rate` naming is updated. Closing DOCS-612. :white_check_mark:
